senses.gloss: f. (matrona) matron, lady (mostly used of Roman women of quality).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 41:10">Gen. R. s. 41</cite>, beg., a. e., v. <cite ref="I00170"><he>טוֹלְמִיסִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 52:13">Gen. R. s. 52</cite> <he>עשאה מ׳</he> he raised her to the rank of a lady (who is protected from the gaze of men, v. <cite ref="K00917"><he>כָּסָה</he> II</cite>).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 44:10">Ex. R. s. 44</cite> <he>נטלה … ועשאה מ׳ וכ׳</he> he took her for wife and made her a lady and gave her a chain &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 4:7">Gen. R. s. 4</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="M01056"><he>מַטְרוֹנוֹת</he></cite>, <he>מַטְרוֹנִיּוֹת</he>, v. <cite ref="M01056">next w.</cite>
